default/32662.htm.text: Guardian of the Great Seal: I am a guardian in charge of the Great Seal in the Chamber of Delusion. What brings you here?

links.text: Ask about the Chamber of Delusion.
Wake up from the Chamber of Delusion.

default/32662-1.htm.text: Guardian of the Great Seal: This is the Great Seal in the Chamber of Delusion. Here are the remains of the challenges, desires and blood of countless heroes. Unlike the other seals, you will not be able to see Einkinel for a limited time (1 day) after a defeat.
